authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data states this dataset contains the administrative boundary for each Local Planning Authority in England and reports 337 LPAs; it is intended to identify the LPA responsible for a planning application/area. A bounded window of at most 50 records was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA reference/name, LAD/statistical-geography reference/name, local-plan/local-plan-boundary/development-plan reference, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any LPA would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
